candidates.question: Which roles from your organization typically attend the vendor meeting, and which specific role is responsible for producing the meeting summary afterward?
What event or condition triggers the scheduling of a vendor meeting — is it recurring on a fixed schedule, initiated by a specific operational issue, or requested on an ad hoc basis?
What tool or system is currently used to record meeting notes and track action items—for example, email threads, a shared document, or a dedicated project management platform?
Which roles or departments are typically involved in the vendor meeting, and who holds primary responsibility for organizing it and producing the post-meeting summary?
What does the meeting summary look like as a finished output—is it a free-text email, a structured template, or a formal document—and who receives it?

In what format is the meeting discussion currently captured — for example, a free-text email, a structured template, or recorded notes — and is there a standard tool or system used to store this output?
How are action items assigned and prioritized after the meeting—is there a defined process for deciding who owns each item and when it must be completed?

When action items are identified from the meeting, how are they recorded and assigned — do they include a designated owner, a due date, and a priority level, and if so, where is this information stored?
What happens when an action item is not completed by its agreed deadline—is there a formal escalation path, an automated reminder, or does it rely on someone manually following up?
How is follow-up on action items currently conducted — for example, through manual email reminders, a task management system, or periodic review meetings — and how frequently does this occur?
How often do these vendor meetings occur, and what is the typical expected turnaround time for resolving the action items that come out of them?
What criteria must be met for this workflow to be considered fully complete — is it when all action items are marked closed, when a final summary report is approved, or some other condition?
